57: /**
58:  * VersionedIntervalTimeline is a data structure that manages objects on a specific timeline.
59:  *
60:  * It associates an {@link Interval} and a generically-typed version with the object that is being stored.
61:  *
62:  * In the event of overlapping timeline entries, timeline intervals may be chunked. The underlying data associated
63:  * with a timeline entry remains unchanged when chunking occurs.
64:  *
65:  * After loading objects via the {@link #add} method, the {@link #lookup(Interval)} method can be used to get the list
66:  * of the most recent objects (according to the version) that match the given interval. The intent is that objects
67:  * represent a certain time period and when you do a {@link #lookup(Interval)}, you are asking for all of the objects
68:  * that you need to look at in order to get a correct answer about that time period.
69:  *
70:  * The {@link #findFullyOvershadowed} method returns a list of objects that will never be returned by a call to {@link
71:  * #lookup} because they are overshadowed by some other object. This can be used in conjunction with the {@link #add}
72:  * and {@link #remove} methods to achieve "atomic" updates. First add new items, then check if those items caused
73:  * anything to be overshadowed, if so, remove the overshadowed elements and you have effectively updated your data set
74:  * without any user impact.
75:  */
76: public class VersionedIntervalTimeline<VersionType, ObjectType extends Overshadowable<ObjectType>>
77:     implements TimelineLookup<VersionType, ObjectType>
78: {
79:   private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock(true);
80: 
81:   // Below timelines stores only *visible* timelineEntries
82:   // adjusted interval -> timelineEntry
83:   private final NavigableMap<Interval, TimelineEntry> completePartitionsTimeline = new TreeMap<>(
84:       Comparators.intervalsByStartThenEnd()
85:   );
86:   // IncompletePartitionsTimeline also includes completePartitionsTimeline
87:   // adjusted interval -> timelineEntry
88:   @VisibleForTesting
89:   final NavigableMap<Interval, TimelineEntry> incompletePartitionsTimeline = new TreeMap<>(
90:       Comparators.intervalsByStartThenEnd()
91:   );
92:   // true interval -> version -> timelineEntry
93:   private final Map<Interval, TreeMap<VersionType, TimelineEntry>> allTimelineEntries = new HashMap<>();
94:   private final AtomicInteger numObjects = new AtomicInteger();
95: 
96:   private final Comparator<? super VersionType> versionComparator;
97: 
98:   // Set this to true if the client needs to skip tombstones upon lookup (like the broker)
99:   private final boolean skipObjectsWithNoData;
100: 
101:   public VersionedIntervalTimeline(Comparator<? super VersionType> versionComparator)
102:   {
103:     this(versionComparator, false);
104:   }
105: 
106:   public VersionedIntervalTimeline(Comparator<? super VersionType> versionComparator, boolean skipObjectsWithNoData)
107:   {
108:     this.versionComparator = versionComparator;
109:     this.skipObjectsWithNoData = skipObjectsWithNoData;
110:   }

112:   public static <VersionType, ObjectType extends Overshadowable<ObjectType>> Iterable<ObjectType> getAllObjects(
113:       final List<TimelineObjectHolder<VersionType, ObjectType>> holders
114:   )
115:   {
116:     return () ->
117:         holders.stream()
118:                .flatMap(holder -> StreamSupport.stream(holder.getObject().spliterator(), false))
119:                .map(PartitionChunk::getObject)
120:                .iterator();
121:   }
122: 
123:   public Map<Interval, TreeMap<VersionType, TimelineEntry>> getAllTimelineEntries()
124:   {
125:     return allTimelineEntries;
126:   }

128:   /**
129:    * Returns a lazy collection with all objects (including partially AND fully overshadowed, see {@link
130:    * #findFullyOvershadowed}) in this VersionedIntervalTimeline to be used for iteration or {@link Collection#stream()}
131:    * transformation. The order of objects in this collection is unspecified.
132:    *
133:    * Note: iteration over the returned collection may not be as trivially cheap as, for example, iteration over an
134:    * ArrayList. Try (to some reasonable extent) to organize the code so that it iterates the returned collection only
135:    * once rather than several times.
136:    */
137:   public Collection<ObjectType> iterateAllObjects()
138:   {
139:     return CollectionUtils.createLazyCollectionFromStream(
140:         () -> allTimelineEntries
141:             .values()
142:             .stream()
143:             .flatMap((TreeMap<VersionType, TimelineEntry> entryMap) -> entryMap.values().stream())
144:             .flatMap((TimelineEntry entry) -> StreamSupport.stream(entry.getPartitionHolder().spliterator(), false))
145:             .map(PartitionChunk::getObject),
146:         numObjects.get()
147:     );
148:   }

150:   public int getNumObjects()
151:   {
152:     return numObjects.get();
153:   }

155:   /**
156:    * Computes a set with all objects falling within the specified interval which are at least partially "visible" in
157:    * this interval (that is, are not fully overshadowed within this interval).
158:    *
159:    * Note that this method returns a set of {@link ObjectType}. Duplicate objects in different time chunks will be
160:    * removed in the result.
161:    */
162:   public Set<ObjectType> findNonOvershadowedObjectsInInterval(Interval interval, Partitions completeness)
163:   {
164:     final List<TimelineObjectHolder<VersionType, ObjectType>> holders;
165: 
166:     lock.readLock().lock();
167:     try {
168:       holders = lookup(interval, completeness);
169:     }
170:     finally {
171:       lock.readLock().unlock();
172:     }
173: 
174:     return FluentIterable
175:         .from(holders)
176:         .transformAndConcat(TimelineObjectHolder::getObject)
177:         .transform(PartitionChunk::getObject)
178:         .toSet();

181:   public void add(final Interval interval, VersionType version, PartitionChunk<ObjectType> object)
182:   {
183:     addAll(Iterators.singletonIterator(new PartitionChunkEntry<>(interval, version, object)));
184:   }

186:   public void addAll(
187:       final Iterator<PartitionChunkEntry<VersionType, ObjectType>> objects
188:   )
189:   {
190:     lock.writeLock().lock();
191: 
192:     try {
193:       final IdentityHashMap<TimelineEntry, Interval> allEntries = new IdentityHashMap<>();
194: 
195:       while (objects.hasNext()) {
196:         PartitionChunkEntry<VersionType, ObjectType> chunkEntry = objects.next();
197:         PartitionChunk<ObjectType> object = chunkEntry.getChunk();
198:         Interval interval = chunkEntry.getInterval();
199:         VersionType version = chunkEntry.getVersion();
200:         Map<VersionType, TimelineEntry> exists = allTimelineEntries.get(interval);
201:         TimelineEntry entry;
202: 
203:         if (exists == null) {
204:           entry = new TimelineEntry(interval, version, new PartitionHolder<>(object));
205:           TreeMap<VersionType, TimelineEntry> versionEntry = new TreeMap<>(versionComparator);
206:           versionEntry.put(version, entry);
207:           allTimelineEntries.put(interval, versionEntry);
208:           numObjects.incrementAndGet();
209:         } else {
210:           entry = exists.get(version);
211: 
212:           if (entry == null) {
213:             entry = new TimelineEntry(interval, version, new PartitionHolder<>(object));
214:             exists.put(version, entry);
215:             numObjects.incrementAndGet();
216:           } else {
217:             PartitionHolder<ObjectType> partitionHolder = entry.getPartitionHolder();
218:             if (partitionHolder.add(object)) {
219:               numObjects.incrementAndGet();
220:             }
221:           }
222:         }
223: 
224:         allEntries.put(entry, interval);
225:       }
226: 
227:       // "isComplete" is O(objects in holder) so defer it to the end of addAll.
228:       for (Entry<TimelineEntry, Interval> entry : allEntries.entrySet()) {
229:         Interval interval = entry.getValue();
230: 
231:         if (entry.getKey().getPartitionHolder().isComplete()) {
232:           add(completePartitionsTimeline, interval, entry.getKey());
233:         }
234: 
235:         add(incompletePartitionsTimeline, interval, entry.getKey());
236:       }
237:     }
238:     finally {
239:       lock.writeLock().unlock();
240:     }
241:   }

243:   @Nullable
244:   public PartitionChunk<ObjectType> remove(Interval interval, VersionType version, PartitionChunk<ObjectType> chunk)
245:   {
246:     lock.writeLock().lock();
247:     try {
248:       Map<VersionType, TimelineEntry> versionEntries = allTimelineEntries.get(interval);
249:       if (versionEntries == null) {
250:         return null;
251:       }
252: 
253:       TimelineEntry entry = versionEntries.get(version);
254:       if (entry == null) {
255:         return null;
256:       }
257: 
258:       PartitionChunk<ObjectType> removedChunk = entry.getPartitionHolder().remove(chunk);
259:       if (removedChunk == null) {
260:         return null;
261:       }
262:       numObjects.decrementAndGet();
263:       if (entry.getPartitionHolder().isEmpty()) {
264:         versionEntries.remove(version);
265:         if (versionEntries.isEmpty()) {
266:           allTimelineEntries.remove(interval);
267:         }
268: 
269:         remove(incompletePartitionsTimeline, interval, entry, true);
270:       }
271: 
272:       remove(completePartitionsTimeline, interval, entry, false);
273: 
274:       return removedChunk;
275:     }
276:     finally {
277:       lock.writeLock().unlock();
278:     }
279:   }

281:   @Override
282:   @Nullable
283:   public PartitionChunk<ObjectType> findChunk(Interval interval, VersionType version, int partitionNum)
284:   {
285:     lock.readLock().lock();
286:     try {
287:       for (Entry<Interval, TreeMap<VersionType, TimelineEntry>> entry : allTimelineEntries.entrySet()) {
288:         if (entry.getKey().equals(interval) || entry.getKey().contains(interval)) {
289:           TimelineEntry foundEntry = entry.getValue().get(version);
290:           if (foundEntry != null) {
291:             return foundEntry.getPartitionHolder().getChunk(partitionNum);
292:           }
293:         }
294:       }
295: 
296:       return null;
297:     }
298:     finally {
299:       lock.readLock().unlock();
300:     }
301:   }
302: 
303:   /**
304:    * Does a lookup for the objects representing the given time interval.  Will *only* return
305:    * PartitionHolders that are {@linkplain PartitionHolder#isComplete() complete}.
306:    *
307:    * @param interval interval to find objects for
308:    *
309:    * @return Holders representing the interval that the objects exist for, PartitionHolders
310:    * are guaranteed to be complete
311:    */
312:   @Override
313:   public List<TimelineObjectHolder<VersionType, ObjectType>> lookup(Interval interval)
314:   {
315:     lock.readLock().lock();
316:     try {
317:       return lookup(interval, Partitions.ONLY_COMPLETE);
318:     }
319:     finally {
320:       lock.readLock().unlock();
321:     }
322:   }
323: 
324:   @Override
325:   public List<TimelineObjectHolder<VersionType, ObjectType>> lookupWithIncompletePartitions(Interval interval)
326:   {
327:     lock.readLock().lock();
328:     try {
329:       return lookup(interval, Partitions.INCOMPLETE_OK);
330:     }
331:     finally {
332:       lock.readLock().unlock();
333:     }
334:   }
335: 
336:   public boolean isEmpty()
337:   {
338:     lock.readLock().lock();
339:     try {
340:       return completePartitionsTimeline.isEmpty();
341:     }
342:     finally {
343:       lock.readLock().unlock();
344:     }
345:   }
346: 
347:   public TimelineObjectHolder<VersionType, ObjectType> first()
348:   {
349:     lock.readLock().lock();
350:     try {
351:       return timelineEntryToObjectHolder(completePartitionsTimeline.firstEntry().getValue());
352:     }
353:     finally {
354:       lock.readLock().unlock();
355:     }
356:   }
357: 
358:   public TimelineObjectHolder<VersionType, ObjectType> last()
359:   {
360:     lock.readLock().lock();
361:     try {
362:       return timelineEntryToObjectHolder(completePartitionsTimeline.lastEntry().getValue());
363:     }
364:     finally {
365:       lock.readLock().unlock();
366:     }
367:   }

369:   private TimelineObjectHolder<VersionType, ObjectType> timelineEntryToObjectHolder(TimelineEntry entry)
370:   {
371:     return new TimelineObjectHolder<>(
372:         entry.getTrueInterval(),
373:         entry.getTrueInterval(),
374:         entry.getVersion(),
375:         PartitionHolder.copyWithOnlyVisibleChunks(entry.getPartitionHolder())
376:     );
377:   }

379:   /**
380:    * This method should be deduplicated with DataSourcesSnapshot.determineOvershadowedSegments(): see
381:    * https://github.com/apache/druid/issues/8070.
382:    */
383:   public Set<TimelineObjectHolder<VersionType, ObjectType>> findFullyOvershadowed()
384:   {
385:     lock.readLock().lock();
386:     try {
387:       // 1. Put all timelineEntries and remove all visible entries to find out only non-visible timelineEntries.
388:       final Map<Interval, Map<VersionType, TimelineEntry>> overshadowedPartitionsTimeline =
389:           computeOvershadowedPartitionsTimeline();
390: 
391:       final Set<TimelineObjectHolder<VersionType, ObjectType>> overshadowedObjects = overshadowedPartitionsTimeline
392:           .values()
393:           .stream()
394:           .flatMap((Map<VersionType, TimelineEntry> entry) -> entry.values().stream())
395:           .map(entry -> new TimelineObjectHolder<>(
396:               entry.getTrueInterval(),
397:               entry.getTrueInterval(),
398:               entry.getVersion(),
399:               PartitionHolder.deepCopy(entry.getPartitionHolder())
400:           ))
401:           .collect(Collectors.toSet());
402: 
403:       // 2. Visible timelineEntries can also have overshadowed objects. Add them to the result too.
404:       for (TimelineEntry entry : incompletePartitionsTimeline.values()) {
405:         final List<PartitionChunk<ObjectType>> overshadowedEntries = entry.partitionHolder.getOvershadowed();
406:         if (!overshadowedEntries.isEmpty()) {
407:           overshadowedObjects.add(
408:               new TimelineObjectHolder<>(
409:                   entry.trueInterval,
410:                   entry.version,
411:                   new PartitionHolder<>(overshadowedEntries)
412:               )
413:           );
414:         }
415:       }
416: 
417:       return overshadowedObjects;
418:     }
419:     finally {
420:       lock.readLock().unlock();
421:     }
422:   }
423: 
424:   private Map<Interval, Map<VersionType, TimelineEntry>> computeOvershadowedPartitionsTimeline()
425:   {
426:     final Map<Interval, Map<VersionType, TimelineEntry>> overshadowedPartitionsTimeline = new HashMap<>();
427:     allTimelineEntries.forEach((Interval interval, TreeMap<VersionType, TimelineEntry> versionEntry) -> {
428:       @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
429:       Map<VersionType, TimelineEntry> versionEntryCopy = (TreeMap) versionEntry.clone();
430:       overshadowedPartitionsTimeline.put(interval, versionEntryCopy);
431:     });
432: 
433:     for (TimelineEntry entry : completePartitionsTimeline.values()) {
434:       overshadowedPartitionsTimeline.computeIfPresent(
435:           entry.getTrueInterval(),
436:           (Interval interval, Map<VersionType, TimelineEntry> versionEntry) -> {
437:             versionEntry.remove(entry.getVersion());
438:             return versionEntry.isEmpty() ? null : versionEntry;
439:           }
440:       );
441:     }
442: 
443:     for (TimelineEntry entry : incompletePartitionsTimeline.values()) {
444:       overshadowedPartitionsTimeline.computeIfPresent(
445:           entry.getTrueInterval(),
446:           (Interval interval, Map<VersionType, TimelineEntry> versionEntry) -> {
447:             versionEntry.remove(entry.getVersion());
448:             return versionEntry.isEmpty() ? null : versionEntry;
449:           }
450:       );
451:     }
452:     return overshadowedPartitionsTimeline;
453:   }

455:   public boolean isOvershadowed(Interval interval, VersionType version, ObjectType object)
456:   {
457:     lock.readLock().lock();
458:     try {
459:       TimelineEntry entry = completePartitionsTimeline.get(interval);
460:       if (entry != null) {
461:         final int majorVersionCompare = versionComparator.compare(version, entry.getVersion());
462:         if (majorVersionCompare == 0) {
463:           for (PartitionChunk<ObjectType> chunk : entry.partitionHolder) {
464:             if (chunk.getObject().overshadows(object)) {
465:               return true;
466:             }
467:           }
468:           return false;
469:         } else {
470:           return majorVersionCompare < 0;
471:         }
472:       }
473: 
474:       Interval lower = completePartitionsTimeline.floorKey(
475:           new Interval(interval.getStart(), new DateTime(Long.MAX_VALUE / 2, ISOChronology.getInstanceUTC()))
476:       );
477: 
478:       if (lower == null || !lower.overlaps(interval)) {
479:         return false;
480:       }
481: 
482:       Interval prev = null;
483:       Interval curr = lower;
484: 
485:       do {
486:         if (curr == null ||  //no further keys
487:             (prev != null && curr.getStartMillis() > prev.getEndMillis()) //a discontinuity
488:         ) {
489:           return false;
490:         }
491: 
492:         final TimelineEntry timelineEntry = completePartitionsTimeline.get(curr);
493:         final int versionCompare = versionComparator.compare(version, timelineEntry.getVersion());
494: 
495:         //lower or same version
496:         if (versionCompare > 0) {
497:           return false;
498:         } else if (versionCompare == 0) {
499:           // Intentionally use the Iterators API instead of the stream API for performance.
500:           //noinspection ConstantConditions
501:           final boolean nonOvershadowedObject = Iterators.all(
502:               timelineEntry.partitionHolder.iterator(), chunk -> !chunk.getObject().overshadows(object)
503:           );
504:           if (nonOvershadowedObject) {
505:             return false;
506:           }
507:         }
508: 
509:         prev = curr;
510:         curr = completePartitionsTimeline.higherKey(curr);
511: 
512:       } while (interval.getEndMillis() > prev.getEndMillis());
513: 
514:       return true;
515:     }
516:     finally {
517:       lock.readLock().unlock();
518:     }
519:   }

521:   @GuardedBy("lock")
522:   private void add(
523:       NavigableMap<Interval, TimelineEntry> timeline,
524:       Interval interval,
525:       TimelineEntry entry
526:   )
527:   {
528:     TimelineEntry existsInTimeline = timeline.get(interval);
529: 
530:     if (existsInTimeline != null) {
531:       int compare = versionComparator.compare(entry.getVersion(), existsInTimeline.getVersion());
532:       if (compare > 0) {
533:         addIntervalToTimeline(interval, entry, timeline);
534:       }
535:       return;
536:     }
537: 
538:     Interval lowerKey = timeline.lowerKey(interval);
539: 
540:     if (lowerKey != null) {
541:       if (addAtKey(timeline, lowerKey, entry)) {
542:         return;
543:       }
544:     }
545: 
546:     Interval higherKey = timeline.higherKey(interval);
547: 
548:     if (higherKey != null) {
549:       if (addAtKey(timeline, higherKey, entry)) {
550:         return;
551:       }
552:     }
553: 
554:     addIntervalToTimeline(interval, entry, timeline);
555:   }

557:   /**
558:    * @return boolean flag indicating whether or not we inserted or discarded something
559:    */
560:   @GuardedBy("lock")
561:   private boolean addAtKey(
562:       NavigableMap<Interval, TimelineEntry> timeline,
563:       Interval key,
564:       TimelineEntry entry
565:   )
566:   {
567:     boolean retVal = false;
568:     Interval currKey = key;
569:     Interval entryInterval = entry.getTrueInterval();
570: 
571:     if (!currKey.overlaps(entryInterval)) {
572:       return false;
573:     }
574: 
575:     while (entryInterval != null && currKey != null && currKey.overlaps(entryInterval)) {
576:       final Interval nextKey = timeline.higherKey(currKey);
577: 
578:       final int versionCompare = versionComparator.compare(
579:           entry.getVersion(),
580:           timeline.get(currKey).getVersion()
581:       );
582: 
583:       if (versionCompare < 0) {
584:         // since the entry version is lower than the existing one, the existing one overwrites the given entry
585:         // if overlapped.
586:         if (currKey.contains(entryInterval)) {
587:           // the version of the entry of currKey is larger than that of the given entry. Discard it
588:           return true;
589:         } else if (currKey.getStart().isBefore(entryInterval.getStart())) {
590:           //       | entry |
591:           //     | cur |
592:           // =>        |new|
593:           entryInterval = new Interval(currKey.getEnd(), entryInterval.getEnd());
594:         } else {
595:           //     | entry |
596:           //         | cur |
597:           // =>  |new|
598:           addIntervalToTimeline(new Interval(entryInterval.getStart(), currKey.getStart()), entry, timeline);
599: 
600:           //     |   entry   |
601:           //       | cur |
602:           // =>          |new|
603:           if (entryInterval.getEnd().isAfter(currKey.getEnd())) {
604:             entryInterval = new Interval(currKey.getEnd(), entryInterval.getEnd());
605:           } else {
606:             // Discard this entry since there is no portion of the entry interval that goes past the end of the curr
607:             // key interval.
608:             entryInterval = null;
609:           }
610:         }
611:       } else if (versionCompare > 0) {
612:         // since the entry version is greater than the existing one, the given entry overwrites the existing one
613:         // if overlapped.
614:         final TimelineEntry oldEntry = timeline.remove(currKey);
615: 
616:         if (currKey.contains(entryInterval)) {
617:           //     |      cur      |
618:           //         | entry |
619:           // =>  |old|  new  |old|
620:           addIntervalToTimeline(new Interval(currKey.getStart(), entryInterval.getStart()), oldEntry, timeline);
621:           addIntervalToTimeline(new Interval(entryInterval.getEnd(), currKey.getEnd()), oldEntry, timeline);
622:           addIntervalToTimeline(entryInterval, entry, timeline);
623: 
624:           return true;
625:         } else if (currKey.getStart().isBefore(entryInterval.getStart())) {
626:           //     |   cur  |
627:           //         |   entry   |
